name: Admin Authentication with Valid Credentials
description: Verify successful authentication of System Administrator using corporate email and PBKDF2 hash credentials.

name: Admin Role Workspace Indicator Badge
description: Verify header displays role-isolated 'Workspace: ADMIN Portal' indicating correct RBAC route guard execution.

name: Administrator User Profile Verification
description: Verify authenticated user's header badge renders the designated administrator identity ('GAYATHRI M').

name: Executive Admin Dashboard KPI Rendering
description: Verify executive analytics command center loads KPI cards: Total Users, Active Projects, System Health.

name: Dashboard Live Analytics Refresh Action
description: Click 'Refresh Analytics' button and ensure asynchronous metrics telemetry updates without runtime errors.

name: User Directory & Account Management View
description: Navigate to Users tab and verify the system account directory table loads with user records from PostgreSQL.

name: User Directory Search & Multi-Field Filtering
description: Search for a specific employee ('krish') in the table search input and verify reactive row filtering.

name: User Directory Search Filter Reset
description: Clear search query and verify full enterprise user roster is restored in the paginated table.

name: User Provisioning Modal Dialog Display
description: Click 'Add Team Member' button and verify modal opens with input fields for full name, email, role, and department.

name: Provision New Team Member Form Submission
description: Submit user provisioning form with new user details and verify instant table insertion & toast notification.

name: User Deprovisioning & Removal Action
description: Click user deprovision (trash) button on the provisioned account and verify removal from active roster.

name: RBAC Roles & Permissions Matrix Inspection
description: Navigate to Roles & Permissions tab and verify the 5 system authorization profiles are rendered with active privileges.

name: Roles Directory Dynamic API Synchronization
description: Click 'Refresh Roles' button to synchronize active role policies directly from the database endpoint.

name: Global Projects Directory & Health Score Audit
description: Navigate to Projects view and verify system projects table loads with health scores, deadlines, and tech lead assignments.

name: Projects Directory Search & Filtering
description: Filter projects by search term ('Verona') and verify reactive filtering of project records.

name: Engineering Teams Directory & Allocation Overview
description: Navigate to Teams view and verify engineering squad allocations, team lead assignments, and capacity bars.

name: System Audit Trail & Security Event Logs Ledger
description: Navigate to Audit Logs tab and verify PostgreSQL-backed security events table with timestamp and event details.

name: Audit Logs Live Refresh Action
description: Trigger 'Refresh Logs' button and confirm dynamic fetch of newest audit log entries.

name: System Diagnostics & Telemetry Logs
description: Navigate to System Logs module and verify diagnostic log table with severity level pills (INFO, WARN, ERROR).

name: Platform Security & JWT Policy Settings View
description: Navigate to Settings tab and verify JWT expiration, password complexity, and lockout policy controls.

name: Platform Configuration Save & Toast Trigger
description: Click 'Save Configuration' button and verify state changes to 'Saved!' with persistent local storage update.

name: Multi-Mode UI Theme Customization (Dark/Light/Warm)
description: Trigger top header theme switcher toggle and verify HTML class updates dynamically between dark and light themes.

name: Administrator Session Termination & Secure Logout
description: Open top user dropdown, click 'Secure Logout' and verify session storage token cleanup and redirection to landing/login.

name: Unauthorized Access & Invalid Password Rejection
description: Attempt authentication using invalid password and verify access rejection and security error alert.
